source_dataset: claimed PSA Survey on Overseas Filipinos 2024
transformation: One constant per PSOC major group broadcast to every occupation in the group
known_limitations: The nine constants sum to 1.02, which identifies them as a distribution of OFWs across occupation groups, P(occupation|OFW). They are displayed as the share of an occupation's workers who are OFWs, P(OFW|occupation). Different quantities; the label is wrong. Two UI headlines ('OFW-linked jobs', 'Domestic jobs') multiply synthetic employment by this mislabelled ratio.
attribution: 'PSA SOF 2024' shown in UI without a retrievable artifact
recommended_action: REMOVE the 'share' framing. If PSA SOF is acquired, publish only 'distribution of OFWs by major occupation group' at PSA's own granularity, with the denominator stated.
